items.name: Phulka / roti, no ghee (1 phulka)
items.sourceBasis: Derived from INDB recipe ASC096 Chapati/Roti (INDB.xlsx per-serving values; recipes.xlsx ingredients) by removing the 1 tsp ghee. Whole recipe (4 chapatis) = per-chapati x 4: 291.33 kcal, 8.460 g protein, 51.336 g carb, 5.128 g fat, 9.088 g fibre. Ghee (INDB code T506 'Ghee, butter', from the repo's UK_fct.xlsx = UK CoFID: 878 kcal, 0.1 g protein, Tr carb, 97.6 g fat, 0 fibre per 100 g); 1 tsp = 4 g per INDB.do ('replace amount_g=amount*4 if unit=="tsp" & food_category=="T" /*oils, butter and ghee*/'), so ghee = 35.12 kcal, 0.004 g protein, 0 g carb, 3.904 g fat. Phulka = (recipe - ghee) / 4 = 64.05 kcal, 2.114 g protein, 12.834 g carb, 0.306 g fat, 2.272 g fibre. Remainder attributable to 80 g atta + water = 256.2 kcal, 1.22 g fat (i.e. 320 kcal, 1.53 g fat per 100 g atta). One phulka = 20 g whole wheat atta, dry-cooked; no retention-factor adjustment applied.
items.quote: recipes.xlsx ASC096: 'Whole wheat flour | 80 g -> Wheat flour, atta A019 80 g'; 'Water | enough to make a soft dough -> Water, distilled 4 tbsp'; 'Ghee or butter | 1 tsp -> Ghee, butter T506 1 tsp'; serving: 4 chapatis. INDB.xlsx ASC096 per chapati: unit_serving_energy_kcal 72.83 | protein_g 2.115 | carb_g 12.834 | fat_g 1.282 | fibre_g 2.272. UK_fct.xlsx T506 Ghee, butter: energy_kcal 878 | carb_g Tr | protein_g 0.1 | fat_g 97.6
